name: Question 2
problem:
The graph of $y=-f(2x)+4,$ can be obtained from the graph of $y=f(x)$ by applying **some** of the following transformations:

- $(\text{T}1)$ - Translation by $4$ units up

- $(\text{T}2)$ - Reflection across the $x$-axis

- $(\text{T}3)$ - Translation by $4$ units down

- $(\text{T}4)$ - Stretch of scale factor $\frac{1}{2}$ parallel to the $x$-axis

Which of the following could be a possible ordering of the appropriate transformations?

Question 2
?

The graph of y=−f(2x)+4, can be obtained from the graph of y=f(x) by applying some of the following transformations:

  • (T1) - Translation by 4 units up

  • (T2) - Reflection across the x-axis

  • (T3) - Translation by 4 units down

  • (T4) - Stretch of scale factor 12 parallel to the x-axis

Which of the following could be a possible ordering of the appropriate transformations?

a
(T4)→(T1)→(T2)
b
(T3)→(T2)→(T4)
c
(T4)→(T2)→(T1)
d
(T4)→(T3)→(T2)
e
(T1)→(T2)→(T4)
Submit
